description: This PHP source file defines a command class for clearing cache namespaces within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a console Command class and implements cache clearing logic with user feedback.

classes.name: CacheClearCommand
classes.description: A command class extending the base Command to clear specific cache namespaces and provide user feedback.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the console command, 'cache:clear'.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the cache clearing process for predefined namespaces, logging success or failure messages and returning appropriate status code.
